NOT FOUND.

What I searched
- Queried the indexed corpus (docs) for MFN / most-favoured/-favored variants:
  - ow_query: "most-favoured-nation pricing clause supplier agreement", and variations including "most-favoured", "most-favored", "most favoured", "most favored", "most-favoured-nation", "most-favored-nation", "MFN".
- Opened the supplier agreements that are readable in the index:
  - supplier-agreement-acme.docx (d134#2 / d134#3) — pages p.0–p.1
  - supplier-agreement-borealis.docx (d135#2 / d135#3) — pages p.0–p.1
  - supplier-agreement-corvid.docx (d136#2 / d136#3) — pages p.0–p.1
  - supplier-agreement-dunmore.docx (d137#2 / d137#3) — pages p.0–p.1
- Ran a file-system grep over the docs folder for patterns: most-fav|most favou|most-favou|most-favored|most-favor|\bMFN\b|most-favoured-nation|most-favored-nation

Findings
- None of the opened/read supplier-agreement files above contain any “most-favoured/-favored” or “MFN” text.
- The index also listed many other supplier-agreement-00X files (e.g. supplier-agreement-005.docx through supplier-agreement-080.docx, refs d110#2..d125#2) as matched but “below the byte cliff” (not opened/read). Those unread files may contain the clause, but I could not read them.

Conclusion
- No readable document in the corpus contained a most-favoured-nation pricing clause. If you want me to check the remaining supplier-agreement-00X files, I can try to add/open them (note: some are currently unreadable in the index).
